# etl-mini

> Declarative in-process ETL: a JSON pipeline of named steps forming a DAG, four built-in transforms, typed retries with injected sleep, and per-step lineage with row fingerprints Python package `trysac-etl-mini`, import name `etl_mini`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
